# WD1 supplementary tables

The eighteen supplementary data tables of drill core **WD1** (Walsdorfer maar, West Eifel Volcanic Field), published as an interactive site on GitHub Pages.

**Browse the tables:** http://fionaschenk.github.io/wdt-tables/

## Outputs

| Output | Caption | Data creator | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`Table1.csv`](docs/downloads/Table1.csv) | Lithology of drill core WD1. | Fiona Schenk | CC BY 4.0 |
| [`Table2.csv`](docs/downloads/Table2.csv) | Average values of tephra samples from drill core WD1 compared to the tuff wall of the Walsdorfer maar. | Fiona Schenk | CC BY 4.0 |
| [`Table3.csv`](docs/downloads/Table3.csv) | Tephra core samples of WD1 in mineralogical components. (JWT = Jungferweiher Tephra, GLT = Glees Tephra, HBT = Hüttenberg Tephra) | Fiona Schenk | CC BY 4.0 |
| [`Table4.csv`](docs/downloads/Table4.csv) | Tephra field samples and their mineralogical components. The Walsdorfer maar (W) defines the sampling location; in total, the samples (cf. a, b, c) were taken from three different areas (1, 2, 3) of the maar. | Fiona Schenk | CC BY 4.0 |
| [`Table5.csv`](docs/downloads/Table5.csv) | Tephra samples from the Goßberg lava pit (G). | Fiona Schenk | CC BY 4.0 |
| [`Table6.csv`](docs/downloads/Table6.csv) | Sampling at quarry Mäuseberg at the Rockeskyll volcano (R). | Fiona Schenk | CC BY 4.0 |
| [`Table7.csv`](docs/downloads/Table7.csv) | Classification of the WD1 tephra samples into primary and secondary tephra. | Fiona Schenk | CC BY 4.0 |
| [`Table8.csv`](docs/downloads/Table8.csv) | EPMA of mineral grains. The average value is calculated from three individual measurements [wt%]. Samples I–1 to III–30 define light mineral grains, samples IIII–1 to IIIIII–30 represent dark mineral grains and two leucites (IIIIII–L1 and IIIIII–L2). Some parameters yielded a too low detectable value (b.d.l. = below detection limit). | Fiona Schenk | CC BY 4.0 |
| [`Table9.csv`](docs/downloads/Table9.csv) | EPMA of four sanidine thin sections from the areas ‘Auf Dickel’ and ‘Am Acker’. The average values ​​shown each include ten measured values ​​[wt%]. Some parameters yielded a too low detectable value (b.d.l. = below detection limit). | Fiona Schenk | CC BY 4.0 |
| [`Table10.csv`](docs/downloads/Table10.csv) | LA–ICP–MS of mineral grains in rare earth elements (REE). The average value is derived from two to three measurement points [ppm] from two mineral grains of the sample. | Fiona Schenk | CC BY 4.0 |
| [`Table11.csv`](docs/downloads/Table11.csv) | LA–ICP–MS of sanidine thin section 2 ‘Auf Dickel’ in rare earth elements (REE). The stated average values ​​[ppm] comprise 70 measurements along the longitudinal axis and 30 measurements across to the longitudinal axis. | Fiona Schenk | CC BY 4.0 |
| [`Table12.csv`](docs/downloads/Table12.csv) | Comparison of brGDGT in drill core WD1. The calculation was carried out according to (1) Raberg et al. (2021), (2) Martínez–Sosa et al. (2021), and (3) Bauersachs et al. (2024). | Fiona Schenk (1), Paul Zander (2), Thorsten Bauersachs (3) | CC BY 4.0 |
| [`Table13.csv`](docs/downloads/Table13.csv) | BrGDGT-based temperature indices in drill core WD1. IR6Me = isomerisation ratio of the 6-methyl brGDGTs; MAAT = mean annual air temperature [°C]; MAF = mean temperature of the months above freezing [°C]. Determined according to Bauersachs et al. (2024). | Thorsten Bauersachs | CC BY 4.0 |
| [`Table14.csv`](docs/downloads/Table14.csv) | BrGDGT algorithm in drill core WD1. The determination was carried out according to Martínez–Sosa et al. (2023). | Paul Zander | CC BY 4.0 |
| [`Table15.csv`](docs/downloads/Table15.csv) | Selected samples from the WD1 core for the analysis of macerals. | Thorsten Bauersachs, Fiona Schenk | CC BY 4.0 |
| [`Table16.csv`](docs/downloads/Table16.csv) | Classification of the macerals into the three main groups. The count was carried out both by number [#] of macerals and by relative proportion [%] in the sample. | Thorsten Bauersachs | CC BY 4.0 |
| [`Table17.csv`](docs/downloads/Table17.csv) | Reflectance measurement of gyttja and sapropel samples from the WD1 core. | Thorsten Bauersachs | CC BY 4.0 |
| [`Table18.csv`](docs/downloads/Table18.csv) | Bulk-geochemical data of WD1 samples. In sample 6, not all parameters yielded a measurable value (n.d. = not detectable) | Thorsten Bauersachs | CC BY 4.0 |
